## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:


It should be noted that in the Power BI I decided to use qualified players with PAs greater or equal to a 10 minimum

```{r}
# ==========================================================
# Combine per-season player SB scoring CSVs into one file
# ==========================================================
# Expects files named like:
#   player_sb_scoring_stats_2009.csv
#   player_sb_scoring_stats_2010.csv
#   ...
#   player_sb_scoring_stats_2025.csv
# (2020 is skipped)
#
# Output:
#   player_sb_scoring_stats_2009_2025.csv
# ==========================================================

# ---- USER SETTINGS ----
input_dir   <- "."   # folder containing the per-season CSVs (use "." for current dir)
output_file <- "player_sb_scoring_stats_2009_2025.csv"

years <- c(2009:2019, 2021:2025)   # 2020 intentionally skipped

# ---- Install + load packages ----
required_pkgs <- c("dplyr", "readr")
to_install <- required_pkgs[!required_pkgs %in% installed.packages()[, "Package"]]
if (length(to_install) > 0) install.packages(to_install)

library(dplyr)
library(readr)

# ---- Build expected file paths ----
files <- file.path(input_dir, sprintf("player_sb_scoring_stats_%d.csv", years))

# Warn about any missing files but keep going with the ones we have
missing_files <- files[!file.exists(files)]
if (length(missing_files) > 0) {
  warning(
    "The following files were not found and will be skipped:\n  ",
    paste(missing_files, collapse = "\n  ")
  )
  files <- files[file.exists(files)]
}

if (length(files) == 0) {
  stop("No per-season CSVs were found in '", input_dir, "'. Check the path.")
}

# ---- Read and combine ----
combined <- files |>
  lapply(readr::read_csv, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::bind_rows() |>
  dplyr::arrange(year, team_name, player_name)

# ---- Write output ----
readr::write_csv(combined, output_file)

cat(sprintf(
  "Done. Combined %d files into '%s' (%d rows).\n",
  length(files), output_file, nrow(combined)
))
print(utils::head(combined))
```

OBP and PA with the CSV above

```{r, echo = FALSE}
# ==========================================================
# Add season OBP and Plate Appearances to the combined CSV
# ==========================================================
# Reads:   player_sb_scoring_stats_2009_2025.csv
# Writes:  player_sb_scoring_stats_2009_2025_with_obp.csv
#
# Adds two columns:
#   season_obp                -> player's OBP for that season
#   season_plate_appearances  -> player's total PA for that season
#
# Pulls directly from the MLB Stats API:
#   https://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1/people/{playerId}/stats
# ==========================================================

# ---- USER SETTINGS ----
input_file  <- "player_sb_scoring_stats_2009_2025.csv"
output_file <- "player_sb_scoring_stats_2009_2025_with_obp.csv"

# Polite pacing between API calls (seconds)
request_delay_sec <- 0.10
max_retries       <- 5
base_backoff_sec  <- 2

# The 30 active MLB franchises (MLB Stats API team IDs).
# Any row whose team_id isn't in here will be dropped.
MLB_TEAM_IDS <- c(
  108,  # Los Angeles Angels
  109,  # Arizona Diamondbacks
  110,  # Baltimore Orioles
  111,  # Boston Red Sox
  112,  # Chicago Cubs
  113,  # Cincinnati Reds
  114,  # Cleveland Guardians
  115,  # Colorado Rockies
  116,  # Detroit Tigers
  117,  # Houston Astros
  118,  # Kansas City Royals
  119,  # Los Angeles Dodgers
  120,  # Washington Nationals
  121,  # New York Mets
  133,  # Oakland / Sacramento Athletics
  134,  # Pittsburgh Pirates
  135,  # San Diego Padres
  136,  # Seattle Mariners
  137,  # San Francisco Giants
  138,  # St. Louis Cardinals
  139,  # Tampa Bay Rays
  140,  # Texas Rangers
  141,  # Toronto Blue Jays
  142,  # Minnesota Twins
  143,  # Philadelphia Phillies
  144,  # Atlanta Braves
  145,  # Chicago White Sox
  146,  # Miami Marlins
  147,  # New York Yankees
  158   # Milwaukee Brewers
)

# ---- Install + load packages ----
required_pkgs <- c("dplyr", "readr", "httr", "jsonlite")
to_install <- required_pkgs[!required_pkgs %in% installed.packages()[, "Package"]]
if (length(to_install) > 0) install.packages(to_install)

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)

# ---- Read combined file ----
if (!file.exists(input_file)) {
  stop("Could not find '", input_file, "'. Set the working directory with setwd() ",
       "or change the input_file path at the top of this script.")
}

dat <- readr::read_csv(input_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Sanity: required columns
need_cols <- c("player_id", "year", "team_id")
missing_cols <- setdiff(need_cols, names(dat))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop("Input is missing required columns: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
}

# ---- Filter: keep only rows whose team_id is one of the 30 MLB franchises ----
n_before <- nrow(dat)
dat <- dat |>
  dplyr::filter(team_id %in% MLB_TEAM_IDS)
n_after <- nrow(dat)

cat(sprintf(
  "Filtered out %d row(s) without an MLB team_id (kept %d of %d).\n",
  n_before - n_after, n_after, n_before
))

if (n_after == 0) {
  stop("No rows remain after filtering to MLB teams. ",
       "Double-check the team_id column in your input file.")
}

# ---- Helper: fetch one (player_id, year) season hitting line ----
fetch_season_hitting <- function(player_id, year) {
  url <- sprintf(
    "https://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1/people/%d/stats?stats=season&group=hitting&season=%d&sportId=1",
    as.integer(player_id), as.integer(year)
  )

  for (attempt in seq_len(max_retries)) {
    resp <- tryCatch(
      httr::GET(url, httr::timeout(30)),
      error = function(e) e
    )

    if (inherits(resp, "error")) {
      msg <- conditionMessage(resp)
    } else if (httr::status_code(resp) == 200) {
      parsed <- tryCatch(
        jsonlite::fromJSON(httr::content(resp, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8"),
                           simplifyVector = FALSE),
        error = function(e) e
      )
      if (inherits(parsed, "error")) {
        msg <- paste("JSON parse failed:", conditionMessage(parsed))
      } else {
        # Walk: parsed$stats[[1]]$splits[[1]]$stat
        splits <- tryCatch(parsed$stats[[1]]$splits, error = function(e) NULL)
        if (is.null(splits) || length(splits) == 0) {
          # No hitting stats for this player-season (e.g., pitcher in pre-DH AL year)
          return(list(obp = NA_real_, pa = NA_integer_))
        }
        stat <- splits[[1]]$stat
        obp_val <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(stat$obp))
        pa_val  <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(stat$plateAppearances))
        return(list(obp = obp_val, pa = pa_val))
      }
    } else {
      msg <- paste("HTTP", httr::status_code(resp))
    }

    # Backoff and retry
    sleep_for <- min(60, base_backoff_sec * (2 ^ (attempt - 1))) + runif(1, 0, 1)
    message(sprintf(
      "  [retry %d/%d] player %d, year %d failed (%s). Sleeping %.1fs...",
      attempt, max_retries - 1, player_id, year, msg, sleep_for
    ))
    Sys.sleep(sleep_for)
  }

  warning(sprintf("Giving up on player %d, year %d after %d retries.",
                  player_id, year, max_retries))
  list(obp = NA_real_, pa = NA_integer_)
}

# ---- Build the unique (player_id, year) lookup table ----
lookup <- dat |>
  dplyr::distinct(player_id, year) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(player_id), !is.na(year)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(year, player_id)

cat(sprintf("Fetching OBP + PA for %d unique (player, season) combinations...\n",
            nrow(lookup)))

obp_vec <- numeric(nrow(lookup))
pa_vec  <- integer(nrow(lookup))

# Simple progress every 25 calls
for (i in seq_len(nrow(lookup))) {
  res <- fetch_season_hitting(lookup$player_id[i], lookup$year[i])
  obp_vec[i] <- res$obp
  pa_vec[i]  <- res$pa
  if (request_delay_sec > 0) Sys.sleep(request_delay_sec)
  if (i %% 25 == 0 || i == nrow(lookup)) {
    cat(sprintf("  ...processed %d / %d\n", i, nrow(lookup)))
  }
}

lookup$season_obp <- obp_vec
lookup$season_plate_appearances <- pa_vec

# ---- Join back into the main dataset and write out ----
out <- dat |>
  dplyr::left_join(lookup, by = c("player_id", "year"))

readr::write_csv(out, output_file)

cat(sprintf("\nDone. Wrote '%s' (%d rows).\n", output_file, nrow(out)))
print(utils::head(out))
```

Code for stolen bases full (some of the data was slightly off, probably due to some amount of tracking differences)
```{r, echo = false}
# ==========================================================
# Bulk-pull season hitting totals for every MLB batter
# from 2009-2025 (skipping 2020) — paginated, includes
# non-qualifying batters via playerPool=All.
#
# Output columns:
#   player_id, player_name, team_id, team_name, year,
#   season_stolen_bases, season_runs, season_obp,
#   season_plate_appearances
#
# Traded players: stats summed across team stints,
# "primary team" = team where player had most PAs.
# ==========================================================

# ---- USER SETTINGS ----
output_file      <- "all_player_season_hitting_2009_2025.csv"
years            <- c(2009:2019, 2021:2025)   # 2020 skipped
page_size        <- 100
hard_max_pages   <- 200
max_retries      <- 5
base_backoff_sec <- 2

# ---- Packages ----
required_pkgs <- c("dplyr", "readr", "httr", "jsonlite")
to_install <- required_pkgs[!required_pkgs %in% installed.packages()[, "Package"]]
if (length(to_install) > 0) install.packages(to_install)

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)

`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a

# ---- Pull one PAGE of a season's hitting stats ----
fetch_page <- function(year, offset) {
  url <- sprintf(
    paste0(
      "https://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1/stats?",
      "stats=season&group=hitting&season=%d&sportId=1",
      "&limit=%d&offset=%d&playerPool=All"
    ),
    year, page_size, offset
  )
  
  for (attempt in seq_len(max_retries)) {
    resp <- tryCatch(httr::GET(url, httr::timeout(60)), error = function(e) e)
    
    if (!inherits(resp, "error") && httr::status_code(resp) == 200) {
      parsed <- tryCatch(
        jsonlite::fromJSON(
          httr::content(resp, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8"),
          simplifyVector = FALSE
        ),
        error = function(e) e
      )
      if (!inherits(parsed, "error")) {
        splits <- parsed$stats[[1]]$splits
        if (is.null(splits) || length(splits) == 0) {
          return(empty_frame())
        }
        rows <- lapply(splits, function(s) {
          data.frame(
            player_id = as.integer(s$player$id %||% NA),
            player_name = as.character(s$player$fullName %||% NA),
            team_id = as.integer(s$team$id %||% NA),
            team_name = as.character(s$team$name %||% NA),
            year = year,
            season_stolen_bases = suppressWarnings(
              as.integer(s$stat$stolenBases %||% NA)
            ),
            season_runs = suppressWarnings(
              as.integer(s$stat$runs %||% NA)
            ),
            season_obp = suppressWarnings(
              as.numeric(s$stat$obp %||% NA)
            ),
            season_plate_appearances = suppressWarnings(
              as.integer(s$stat$plateAppearances %||% NA)
            )
          )
        })
        return(dplyr::bind_rows(rows))
      }
    }
    
    msg <- if (inherits(resp, "error")) conditionMessage(resp)
    else paste("HTTP", httr::status_code(resp))
    sleep_for <- min(60, base_backoff_sec * (2 ^ (attempt - 1))) + runif(1, 0, 1)
    message(sprintf("  retry %d/%d for %d offset %d (%s) — sleeping %.1fs",
                    attempt, max_retries - 1, year, offset, msg, sleep_for))
    Sys.sleep(sleep_for)
  }
  
  warning(sprintf("Giving up on year %d offset %d.", year, offset))
  empty_frame()
}

# Convenience constructor for empty frames matching the schema
empty_frame <- function() {
  data.frame(
    player_id = integer(0),
    player_name = character(0),
    team_id = integer(0),
    team_name = character(0),
    year = integer(0),
    season_stolen_bases = integer(0),
    season_runs = integer(0),
    season_obp = numeric(0),
    season_plate_appearances = integer(0)
  )
}

# ---- Pull a full season by paging until empty ----
fetch_season <- function(year) {
  pages <- list()
  for (p in seq_len(hard_max_pages)) {
    offset <- (p - 1) * page_size
    page <- fetch_page(year, offset)
    if (nrow(page) == 0) break
    pages[[p]] <- page
    if (nrow(page) < page_size) break
    Sys.sleep(0.15)
  }
  dplyr::bind_rows(pages)
}

# ---- Loop the years ----
all_seasons <- list()
for (yr in years) {
  cat(sprintf("Pulling %d ...\n", yr))
  s <- fetch_season(yr)
  cat(sprintf("  ...%d raw rows for %d (before dedup)\n", nrow(s), yr))
  all_seasons[[as.character(yr)]] <- s
  Sys.sleep(0.3)
}

# ---- Aggregate traded players into one row per (player, year) ----
combined <- dplyr::bind_rows(all_seasons) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(player_id)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(player_id, year) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    player_name = dplyr::first(player_name[!is.na(player_name)]),
    team_id    = team_id[which.max(season_plate_appearances)][1],
    team_name  = team_name[which.max(season_plate_appearances)][1],
    season_stolen_bases      = sum(season_stolen_bases, na.rm = TRUE),
    season_runs              = sum(season_runs, na.rm = TRUE),
    season_plate_appearances = sum(season_plate_appearances, na.rm = TRUE),
    season_obp = stats::weighted.mean(
      season_obp, season_plate_appearances, na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    player_id, player_name, team_id, team_name, year,
    season_stolen_bases, season_runs, season_obp, season_plate_appearances
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(year, player_id)

readr::write_csv(combined, output_file)
cat(sprintf("\nDone. Wrote %d rows to '%s'.\n", nrow(combined), output_file))
print(utils::head(combined))

```
